ambiguity: Reasons: policy is discussed as something to be read narrowly, not as a ground for the decision. I coded it as a minor ground since the text frames the action as an exception to OPS-14, but it could be left out. Discomfort: the text stresses the irreversible harm but does not voice unease or regret, so I coded false. Remedy: the text does not ask anyone to stop the destruction because the writer acts alone. It does notify the manager and put the matter before the Tuesday sitting, and I coded that as flag_for_review. It could also be read as merely reporting what was done.
